trait.name: Stored Dawn
entries: The gleaner sheds Dim Light in a 5-foot radius. It can suppress or restore this light at the start of its turn (no action required).

trait.name: Light Forager
entries: The gleaner knows the direction of the nearest source of Bright Light within 60 feet that isn't behind Total Cover. This trait doesn't reveal creatures or objects hidden within that light.

bonus.name: Spill the Lantern (1/Day)
entries: The gleaner releases its stored light, then moves up to 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks. Until the start of its next turn, its space sheds Bright Light in a 10-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 10 feet. It can't shed light with Stored Dawn again until it finishes a Short or Long Rest.

trait.name: Borrowed Horizon
entries: While in Dim Light, the prowler has Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks. It loses this benefit until the end of its next turn whenever it deals Radiant damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The prowler makes two Prism Fang attacks.

action.name: Prism Fang
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) Piercing damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) Radiant damage.

action.name: Split Sunset {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 14}, each creature in a 30-foot-long, 5-foot-wide Line originating from the prowler. {@actSaveFail} 27 ({@damage 6d8}) Radiant damage, and the prowler can push the target up to 10 feet directly away from itself. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

bonus.name: Follow the Gleam
entries: The prowler teleports up to 20 feet to an unoccupied space it can see in Bright Light or Dim Light. Its destination can't be behind Total Cover from its original space.

reaction.name: Turn the Facet
entries: Trigger: The prowler is hit by an attack roll made by a creature it can see. Response: The prowler gains a +3 bonus to AC against that attack, potentially causing it to miss.

monster.name: Kiln of the Ninth Dawn

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
entries: If the kiln fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Furnace Heart
entries: The kiln sheds Bright Light in a 30-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 30 feet. Its light can't be suppressed by a spell of level 3 or lower that creates magical darkness.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The kiln makes two Meridian Arm attacks.

action.name: Meridian Arm
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 10}, reach 15 ft. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d10 + 5}) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Radiant damage.

action.name: Cast the Morning {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 18}, each creature in a 45-foot Cone. {@actSaveFail} 44 ({@damage 8d10}) Radiant damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

bonus.name: Set the Meridian
entries: The kiln chooses one unoccupied space on a surface it can see within 60 feet. A visible 10-foot-radius circle of amber light appears centered on that space until the start of the kiln's next turn. That area is Difficult Terrain for creatures other than the kiln. When a creature enters that area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw ({@dc 18}) or have its Speed reduced by 10 feet until the end of that turn. A creature makes this save only once per turn. The kiln can have only one such circle active at a time.

legendaryHeader: Legendary Action Uses: 3. Immediately after another creature's turn, the kiln can expend a use to take one of the following actions. The kiln regains all expended uses at the start of each of its turns.

legendary.name: Loose Spark
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 18}, one creature the kiln can see within 60 feet. {@actSaveFail} 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Radiant damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

legendary.name: Orbit
entries: The kiln moves up to half its Fly Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

legendary.name: Recast the Meridian
entries: The kiln uses Set the Meridian.
